errors.evidence: The description mentions 'returns' (възвръщаемости), which are not shown in the charts. The charts only display prices. This information seems to be taken from the paper's caption, not the figure itself.

errors.text_span: Оста X представлява времето, отбелязано като дати, започващи от 15 Януари 2021 г. и завършващи приблизително около 15 март 2022 г. Скалата е линейна. Оста X е разделена на интервали от приблизително 15 дни.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly treats the two separate charts as having a single, shared X-axis. In reality, the left chart's X-axis shows dates from April 2021 to March 2022 at monthly intervals, while the right chart's X-axis shows days numbered from 1 to 239 at 14-day intervals.
The x-axis for the left chart clearly starts on '15-Apr-21', not '15 January 2021'.

The y-axis does not have any units explicitly mentioned. While 'dollars per barrel' is a reasonable assumption based on the context of oil prices, the prompt requires describing only what is visually present, without making assumptions.

errors.evidence: The visible range of the Y-axis on both charts is from 50 to 130, not 60 to 130.
The intervals between the labels on the Y-axis are uniform, marked every 10 units (50, 60, 70, etc.).

errors.evidence: This misrepresents the trend of the 'Real price data' line. The drop to around 70 occurs in December 2021, before the final sharp rise to the peak. After the peak near 128, the line drops to its final value around 105, not 70.
